name: compact-producer-contract
authority: D-S14 item 3 (fix the causes, never the checks); the loop records the decision that adopts it in docs/loop/DECISIONS.md

applies_to.path: the compact producer under report_optimized: a wrapper bound by compact_contracts.bind_producer with the validated messages

serialisation: canonical: sorted keys, compact separators, non-ASCII kept (json.dumps sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False). All 84 DEV replies of checkpoint 168 (docs/fix/producer_tuning_v3_run, checkpoint-168 full_dev.jsonl) are byte for byte this serialisation, so the item keys run in sorted order, not in the order the contract's example names them.
description: A logits constraint built per request from the request's own declaration, with compact_contracts.producer unchanged behind it. Only replies of the canonical shape can be generated: the envelope with exactly one item per owned alias, in the owned order; every item key present, in canonical order; span the next owned alias; claims only CLM ids written in that span's text; refs only that span's grounded set (REF ids in its text and the passages bounded_extraction.grounding placed in it); status extracted exactly when claims, questions or uncertainty is non-empty; questions and uncertainty the model's own JSON strings, non-blank and not repeated; or the refusal object, which the validator refuses as before. The id patterns are the validator's own (a check holds them equal to compact_contracts.producer). Nothing here changes the frozen decoding policy: greedy stays greedy, and a token the model would have chosen anyway is never changed.
